# packages
pacman::p_load(tidyverse) 

# read in manually downloaded pathogen watch data

read_and_bind <- function(file_list) {
  data_list <- lapply(file_list, read.csv)
  
  # union of all column names across files
  all_columns <- Reduce(union, lapply(data_list, colnames))
  
  # add missing columns with NA to each dataframe
  data_list <- lapply(data_list, function(df) {
    df[setdiff(all_columns, colnames(df))] <- NA
    df
  })
  
  bind_rows(data_list)
}

get_presence_absence_matrix <- function(df,variable){
  presences <- str_split(unlist(c(df %>% dplyr::select(paste0(variable)))),",") %>% unlist(.)  %>% unique(.) %>% .[!. %in% "-"] %>% sort %>% subset(. != "")
  vector <- as.vector(tidyr::unite(df %>% dplyr::select(paste0(variable)),determinants,sep =",")) %>% unlist() %>% as.vector
  results <- matrix(nrow = nrow(df),ncol=length(presences))  %>% `colnames<-`(presences)
for(i in presences){
  results[,paste0(i)] <- as.vector(ifelse(unlist(lapply(str_split(as.matrix(df[,paste0(variable)]),","), function(x) i %in% x))==TRUE,1,0))
}
  rownames(results) <- rownames(df)
  return(results)
}

ng_snp <- read_and_bind(list.files("../../data/ng_pathogenwatch_files/amr_snps_by_5k/", pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE))
rownames(ng_snp) <- ng_snp$Genome.Name

ng_snp_variants <- get_presence_absence_matrix(ng_snp, "Variants")
ng_snp_acquired <- get_presence_absence_matrix(ng_snp, "Acquired")

ng_snp <- cbind(ng_snp[,1:4], ng_snp_variants, ng_snp_acquired)

write_rds(ng_snp, file = "../../data/ng_pathogenwatch_files/ng_snps.RDS")
saveRDS(list(script = "scripts/pathogenwatch/source_preparation/01__2025-01-27_pathogenwatch_redownload.Rmd", original_script = "../../2024_NG_enrichment_probe_creation/2025-01-27_pathogenwatch_redownload.Rmd", input_files = list.files("../../data/ng_pathogenwatch_files/amr_snps_by_5k/", pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE), generated_at = Sys.time()), "../../data/ng_pathogenwatch_files/ng_snps_provenance.RDS")
